morgan: Quick GA sync — were aiming to flip Marketplace live Friday 10:00 PT. Need final confirmations: badges, blog embargo, SI standby, and CDN purge.
tess: Badges ready. Uploaded to /assets/partner-badges-v3.zip. CDN purge scheduled Fri 08:30 PT.
raj: SI standby confirmed 08:00-16:00 PT. Will send 15-min runbook highlights and a 20m dry-run Thu 15:00 PT.
linda: Comms: blog + presskit ready, but legal flagged a line about "no downtime". I removed it. PR embargo set Fri 10:00 PT.
badge-bot: Asset checksum: 9f2a3b. Reminder: include partner logo attribution sheet in package.
morgan: Thanks. Two quick asks: (1) tess, please add co-branded quickstart PDF to the badge package; (2) raj, include rollback trigger in runbook (error rate >2% or latency >2x).
tess: Will add quickstart by Thu COB.
raj: Added rollback trigger. Will circulate runbook Thu 09:00 PT.
linda: PR helpline rota: 09:30-12:30 staffed by PR + partnerships. Posting rota now.
morgan: Excellent. If no major blockers by Thu EOD, call this lane green and well proceed with go/no-go on Fri 08:00 PT. :rocket:
